definitions.explanation: The process of absorbing or soaking up water. Used for materials, products, and natural processes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吸水|きゅうすい}{力|りょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This towel has high water absorption.

examples.japanese: {吸水|きゅうすい}⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敷|し}いた→敷く：00366_shiku⟧。
examples.english: I laid an absorbent sheet on the floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吸水|きゅうすい}{性|せい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Dry soil has poor water absorption, and water runs off quickly.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used as a modifier in compound expressions describing the water-absorbing properties of materials and products.

NOTE: Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧ (water supply), which refers to providing or delivering water rather than absorbing it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吸水|きゅうすい}{力|りょく} (water absorption capacity)
- {吸水|きゅうすい}{性|せい} (absorbency)
- {吸水|きゅうすい}⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧ (absorbent towel)
- {吸水|きゅうすい}⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧ (absorbent sheet)
